scope: Tasman Council 2026 ordinary election and current-office evidence

sources.title: TEC final 2026 Tasman Council results
sources.finding: The official final contest tabs were read in a cloud browser. The councillor tab contains both the initial unopposed and later contested rows.

sources.title: TEC 2026 Tasman nomination sequence
sources.finding: The official candidate page distinguishes original unopposed nominations and the reopened nomination period for the remaining seats.

sources.title: Tasman Council office declaration and roster review
sources.finding: The Council’s published directory still shows its pre-election membership, including Maria Stacey as Deputy Mayor. The July 2026 TEC roster is archived. The 2026 election results below give the elected names; current declarations of office remain unverified.
